decisions.reason: The source selects a visual design reference while the supplied context explicitly preserves the client's logo, colors, and branding.
Selecting the competitor design reference does not change the existing mobile-friendly requirement.
The design-reference choice does not alter the master site's national role, booking arrangement, or positioning.
The source does not change location selection behavior, available locations, or routing destinations.
The visual reference is owned by the source design requirement and does not change template reuse, the Seattle template basis, or redesign requirements.
The source does not change the requirement for dedicated location pages or cross-location design and branding consistency.
Choosing a design reference does not add, remove, or modify any required homepage section or offering visibility rule.
The visual design direction does not affect the Wix booking platform, booking host, or Seattle booking activation behavior.
The source does not change any location-level isolation rule for bookings, data, analytics, reporting, or access.
The design-reference selection does not change Seattle's coming-soon mode, required sections, button label, or opening transition.
The source does not change the VIP email signup behavior or its button label.
The visual design-reference decision does not alter separate payment setups or payout isolation between locations.
